# PageOrientation

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Provides the supported portrait and landscape page orientations.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new PageOrientation()
```

## Properties

- [`Landscape`](#landscape): The longer side of the page size is the page width.
- [`Portrait`](#portrait): The shorter side of the page size is the page width.

### `Landscape`

```typescript
static readonly Landscape: "Landscape"
```

*static, read-only*

The longer side of the page size is the page width.

### `Portrait`

```typescript
static readonly Portrait: "Portrait"
```

*static, read-only*

The shorter side of the page size is the page width.
